title: MITRA-Bench single-turn screen item
description: A cheap, single-turn regression check derived from the lexicon, per the proposal's own description: 'template-generated from the lexicon and fully human-reviewed, which meets the guidance's floor for simple evals and gives developers a fast regression check.' Tests idiom recognition and resource accuracy in isolation, never full multi-turn escalation timing (D2) or continuity (D5), since a single turn cannot exercise either.

lexicon_id.description: The lexicon entry this item was templated from; every screen item must trace to a lexicon entry, never invented independently.

user_message.description: A single realistic user turn built around the lexicon phrase.

dimensions_applicable.description: Single-turn items can only test D1 (acknowledgment), D4 (non-pathologising), D3 (resource accuracy, only if a resource is warranted or given) and D6 (distortion handling, only if the phrase carries a distortion_type). D2 (timing across turns) and D5 (continuity) require multi-turn context and are never applicable here.

expected_behaviour.description: Plain statement of what a passing response looks like at this severity, written so a grader can check it without inferring intent.
